answer: The beacon schedule is applied in dune and kernel shows each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3949 identities would post 2200 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
